_comment: The series itself, and the only place that knows how long it is. BOOK_MAX, the reading-position selector, the spoiler prompt and the validator's bounds all derive from `released` here, so a new book is an edit to this file rather than a constant hunt across three layers. Taylor has said book 7 will be the last; it has no title yet, so it is recorded here in prose rather than as an entry, because an entry with no title is a shape every renderer would have to special-case. `released` is a stored boolean and deliberately not a comparison against today's date: the page is static and its golden master is exact, so a date comparison would make the rendered output change by itself overnight and break the snapshot with nobody having touched anything. Flip it by hand, rebuild, re-record. That is the whole release-day procedure.
